Also please set up [pre-commits locally](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine/introduction.html#setting-up-a-dev-environment) to help with formatting

This doesn't look right. You replaced file name with full path. Any reason for that?
Although it doesn't seem to cause problems 🤔
That doesn't look discoverable, although it's the same in Scene dock. I wonder how users are supposed to know about this shortcut.
It's a PopupMenu, so button style does not apply here.
Adding a whole method is not needed right now, because the options are added only in one place. You can just extract these 2 lines and remove the method.

Not needed here.
```suggestion
		FILTER_BY_TYPE,
```
The value can never be empty here, so the condition is redundant.
This was most likely left over from the GUI version.
The method is now being used in more than one place so I kept it.

This line change seems to be missing in the latest commit, so type filtering does not work (the type is always empty).

(I was going to comment that in the last review, but it didn't send by accident)

```suggestion
		FILTER_BY_TYPE = 64,
```
Needed again, since you added this option to another menu (there is conflict).
